entities.name: Query sequence GBA-like
observations: 450-aa query has 61.2% identity and 99.3% query coverage to reviewed human lysosomal acid glucosylceramidase P04062; homology supports GBA1-like function.
Pfam detects Glyco_hydro_30 and Glyco_hydro_30C domains, supporting a glycoside hydrolase family 30 assignment.
Likely role by close homology: lysosomal hydrolysis of glucosylceramide to ceramide and glucose; participates in sphingolipid degradation and membrane-lipid turnover.
Likely location by close homology: lysosomal lumen/peripheral lysosomal membrane association; localization details are reference annotations, not directly measured for query.
Sequence contains ambiguous X residues; annotation is inferred from homology rather than query-specific experimental evidence.

entities.name: Human GBA1 P04062
observations: Reviewed human lysosomal acid glucosylceramidase; catalyzes glucosylceramide hydrolysis to ceramide and glucose and contributes to sphingolipid/cholesterol metabolism.
Annotated to lysosome, lysosomal lumen and membrane; association with saposin C and lysosomal targeting via SCARB2 are reported.
